reply.text:
Good on you for wanting to train this young. At 12, the way to get strong is to learn the movements well and build the habit, so think technique first, not heavy weight. Bodyweight work like push-ups, squats, and pull-ups, plus light weights, with a coach, PE teacher, or parent keeping an eye on your form, is the right place to start.

Size comes later, mostly from growing, eating enough real food, and sleeping well. Ten hours a night does more for you than any lifting trick. Ask a parent or your doctor before starting a lifting routine, and skip supplements and protein powders at your age.

What sports or activities do you already do? That tells me where to start.
